paragraphs.text: You press yourself against the biggest trunk you can find. Two horses draw near, their riders holding up lanterns. Branches cast a maze of shifting shadows across you as they pass. You get a momentary look at the face of one rider. He looks drawn and anxious. Then they head away to the east.
Once you are sure they are out of earshot, you make your way through the woods. It seems wise to avoid the road.
You may check-mark the small box beside the Stealth skill. Go to 223.
